title: What happens if you stop drinking soda for 30 days?
sources: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

lines.text: What happens inside your body if you replace all sodas with pure water for thirty days?
lines.caps: What happens if you | *quit soda | for *30 days?

lines.text: A single can of soda contains nearly ten teaspoons of liquid high fructose corn syrup.
lines.caps: One can packs *ten teaspoons | of liquid | *sugar

lines.text: During the first three days, you will likely experience caffeine withdrawal headaches and intense sugar cravings.
By day ten, your insulin sensitivity dramatically resets, stopping afternoon energy crashes.
lines.caps: By day ten | your insulin *resets | and energy *soars

lines.text: Your kidneys and liver stop processing massive acid loads, and your tooth enamel begins remineralizing.
After thirty days, you can lose up to five pounds of visceral fat while lowering cardiovascular inflammation.
lines.caps: You lose *5 pounds | of dangerous | *belly fat!

lines.text: Try thirty days without soda and feel how much cleaner your body runs.
